headline: Passage Holds Pace as Berm Stirs Anew
war_summary: Since the 09:00 edition the Passage has held its pace with eight more changes in two hours to 11:55 for twenty on the day about Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage, now counting eight Warden and two Colonial holds with 24-hour losses of 10,639 Colonial and 11,545 Warden and both casualty rates accelerating. Palantine Berm has reawakened with three changes in two hours to 11:55 for thirty-three on the day, all Warden-held, centered on Leiri Hermanni. The Shelf remains near with two changes in two hours to 12:11 for eighteen on the day at one Warden, seven Colonial and one unheld about Briar, with losses of 3,156 and 3,480. The Expanse shows one change in two hours to 10:16 for thirty-nine on the day at seven Colonial and two unheld about Wightwalk and Crow's Nest, with losses of 5,554 and 9,225. The Nevish Line has gone quiet in the last two hours, last heard at 09:47 with six in six hours for thirty-nine on the day at six Warden and two Colonial, while Stonecradle and Mooring County report no changes in two hours.
